description: Retrieval recall@5 test set. Each query is a finding-style statement; 'relevant' lists the corpus pages that contain supporting text. Retrieval runs over paragraph chunks of all corpus pages; a page counts as found if any of its chunks is in the top 5. 'paraphrase' marks queries worded without the page's key terms (where embeddings should help).
